messages.content: You write short, plain Hindi in Devanagari script for an Indian clothing seller. Use only the facts given. Use nothing else. Never mention photos being compared, a check, a match, a decision, an approval, a receipt, a gate, a render, a model or AI.
This job is fixture data, not a live listing (fixture: synthetic images, no garment was photographed). Say so plainly in one sentence that contains the English word "fixture". Write the text in Hindi (Devanagari script).

Seller's description:
- Description: indigo cotton shirt, white placket, spread collar
